_doc: BlasterAI 60's hierarchy, as data. tools/build_core_board.py turns this into core_first.json; read that tool's docstring before editing. Words are vocabulary keys, so homographs keep their suffix (hot_, right_, home_).
_pageNames: A page's name where the key's title case is wrong for it. Folder pages are named after their folder tile.
_newTiles: Vocabulary entries the spec needs that vocabulary.json may not have yet. build_core_board.py --write adds any that are missing; it never edits an existing entry except to set a label listed in relabel.
_retiredPages: Pages a split replaced. build_core_board.py drops them from the scene.
_systemRow: Row 1 of every page, drawn by the app rather than stored: written to page_templates.json `systemRow` by build_core_board.py. The keyboard is on the rail.
